description: Manage QEMU disk images for virtual machines. List available images, create new qcow2/raw disk images, or delete existing ones. Images are stored in the DeepADB image directory.

format.description: Image format. qcow2 is recommended (sparse, snapshots). raw for maximum I/O performance.

name.description: Image name (for create/delete). Alphanumeric, hyphens, underscores only.

sizeMb.description: Image size in MB (for create). Default 8192 (8GB). Range: 64-65536.

name: adb_qemu_images
